description: This Java source file defines the 'Notification' class, an entity representing user notifications in the system, with fields for id, username, message, read status, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Entity representing a user notification, with fields for id, username, message, read flag, and created at timestamp, mapped to the 'notifications' table in the database.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username of the notification recipient.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username of the notification recipient.

methods.name: isReadFlag
methods.description: Checks if the notification has been read.

methods.name: setReadFlag
methods.description: Sets the read status of the notification.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the notification.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the notification.
